assessment.system: Findependence household-finance prototype, hosted form (with shared/ and core/)
assessment.independence: NOT independent: the same AI system family wrote the code under review. This assessment cannot discharge GATE-016 1_security_review or DEF-026.
assessment.environment: dev container; hosted test endpoint against PostgreSQL 17.11 database findependence_hosted_test_assess2; 17 assessment tests run twice (17/17 both), full hosted suite 474/474
assessment.trust_model: trusted operator (REV-111, CP-024 A), disclosed at sign-up (REQ-180)

findings.title: The hosted form's access state is unauthenticated: whoever can write the database can forge requests and agreements, and can remove an owner for good
affected_principals: P7 runtime role credentials if stolen
findings.affected_people_or_households_scope: any household whose rows the writer can change
findings.operator_access_relevance: Within REV-111's trust for the operator; matters for a database compromise that isn't the operator
attack_prerequisites: an honest owner then agrees (forged request) or makes any change to the item (owner removal)
findings.impact: A forged request with a forged co-owner agreement is shown as 'Agreed so far: Cal'; the honest owner's agreement applies it and seals the item key to the new reader. Deleting an owner row makes the next save drop that owner's key; restoring the row doesn't restore access. No integrity issue is reported.
findings.financial_harm: Disclosure and loss of access; no money movement exists.
findings.privacy_harm: An item's content disclosed to a member the owners didn't choose; a co-owner locked out of their own record.
findings.reproduction: hosted/test/assessment/assess002_test.exs: 'DI-1 FAILS: a forged request...' and 'DI-1 FAILS: deleting an owner's row...'
findings.remediation: Extend DESIGN-002's signed operation log (CP-027 A) to the hosted form: access-state changes signed by the members whose consent they need, verified on load; unsigned requests or agreements reported and never applied. Interim alternative: a server signature over the access state with a key outside the database.
findings.regression_test: E-112 and E-113 inverted: the forged request is refused and reported; Cal keeps their key.

findings.title: A database or backup copy allows offline guessing of members' passphrases
affected_principals: anyone holding a database or backup copy
findings.affected_people_or_households_scope: each member with a guessable passphrase
findings.operator_access_relevance: Decides whether the database and backup paths are cryptographically closed to an ordinary operator
attack_prerequisites: a copy of the accounts table
findings.impact: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 600,000 iterations with a stored salt and no server-held secret; the only passphrase rule is 12 characters. A guessed passphrase opens the member's private key: all they can read, and signing as them.
findings.reproduction: Inspection of the stored format (salt, iteration count, wrapped key) in the accounts table; no server secret enters the derivation.
findings.remediation: Mix a pepper held outside the database (secret manager or KMS) into the key-wrapping key; refuse the most common passphrases; consider a memory-hard KDF when available without a third-party cryptography library.
findings.regression_test: Without the pepper, no stored wrapped key opens.

findings.title: The operator holds signed-in members' keys, with no customer-authorized elevation and no separate emergency mechanism
findings.affected_people_or_households_scope: every signed-in member; every member at their next sign-in
attack_prerequisites: code execution in the node, deployment authority, or host root
findings.impact: Another process in the node read the public sessions table and decrypted a signed-in member's item. One operator can enable the console alone; it is recorded in the database the operator administers.
findings.privacy_harm: Standing operator access to content, disclosed at sign-up (REQ-180).
findings.remediation: Accepted (CP-024 A). Defense in depth: make the sessions table :protected; ship audit records off-host continuously; name the approval reference in the boot record. The brief's OE model needs a client-encrypted architecture (ARCH-004 section 5).

findings.title: The household's item limit tells a member how many items others hold
findings.affected_people_or_households_scope: members of one household, about each other
attack_prerequisites: adding (and deleting) items up to the limit
findings.impact: With the limit at 5 and 3 private items held by Ana, Ben could add 2 and inferred 3. At 2,000 the same count is reachable by adding and deleting.
findings.privacy_harm: How much another member records; a weak signal of activity.
findings.remediation: A per-member limit that binds before any household ceiling.
findings.regression_test: E-104 inverted: Ben's capacity doesn't depend on Ana's items.

findings.title: Request numbers count every request in the household
findings.impact: Ben's request was number 4 after two requests he had no part in.
findings.privacy_harm: That others share or change ownership, not what or between whom.
findings.remediation: Random request identifiers, or numbering per member.

findings.title: Confirmation messages carrying item names travel in a signed but unencrypted session cookie
affected_principals: anyone with the browser's cookie store
a TLS-terminating component that logs cookies
findings.operator_access_relevance: a proxy that logs cookies would see item names
findings.impact: The cookie payload decodes, without a key, to text containing the item's name.
findings.privacy_harm: Item names outside the encrypted store.
findings.reproduction: hosted/test/assessment/assess002_test.exs: 'DM-1 FAILS (low): the confirmation after a change...'
findings.remediation: Set encryption_salt on the hosted session, as WI-079 did for the local form (ASSESS-001 FND-15).

findings.title: The LiveView socket is mounted in production with nothing to serve
findings.impact: An unused WebSocket and long-poll endpoint; joining needs a signed token for a routed view, and none is routed in production.
findings.reproduction: Static: the socket is mounted unconditionally; /specimen is routed only with :specimen_route.

findings.title: Smaller observations: no x-frame-options (CSP frame-ancestors covers it); any member can admit a new member; revocation re-seals nothing
A database writer holding an earlier copy can restore a whole household, code and all, undoing revocations
findings.status: CONFIRMED; mitigated by WI-086 (REQ-198 AC-5), not yet merged
affected_principals: anyone with a backup and write access
attack_prerequisites: an earlier copy of the household's rows
findings.impact: A revoked grant is back after the restore, with no refusal and no notice.
findings.reproduction: hosted/test/assessment/assess002_test.exs: 'RE-RUN FINDING: restoring a whole earlier copy...'
findings.remediation: A per-household counter covered by the code and kept outside the database (append-only store; members' browsers for detection); DESIGN-002's outside checkpoint.

findings.title: A member can fill another's item limit by giving them items they never agreed to
findings.status: CONFIRMED; mitigated by WI-086 (REQ-115 for every item), not yet merged
findings.impact: The receiving member can't add items until they delete what they were given.
findings.reproduction: hosted/test/assessment/assess002_test.exs: 'RE-RUN FINDING: a member can fill another's item limit...'
findings.remediation: Count only items a member made or accepted, or require the receiver's agreement before an item becomes theirs.

findings.title: Account rows aren't covered by the records' code: a copied wrapped key breaks a member's session without reaching content
findings.status: INFERRED; mitigated by WI-086 (REQ-182 AC-5), not yet merged
findings.impact: Sign-in as the account with another passphrase yields the wrong key; key box and pins don't open; a 500 and a locked-out member.
findings.remediation: Cover the account's key fields with a code under the server key, or accept as availability only.
findings.regression_test: A swapped wrapped key is refused at sign-in.

rerun.checks: hosted gate 488, assessment and WI-085 tests 31/31 twice, core 201, shared 9, app 633; secrets scan 5 commits clean
